2025-02-02.name: Kimi to Idol Precure
2025-02-02.desc:
"Let's sing, dance, and please the crowd! You and I! Kirakilala~!"

Sakura Uta, an eighth-grade student with a passion for singing, encounters a mysterious fairy named Purirun, who is searching for the Legendary Saviors known as "Idol Precure." Purirun's homeland, Kirakiland, has fallen into darkness due to the villainous Team Chokkiri, led by Darkine, who begins stealing sparkles from Hanamichi Town's residents. Determined to restore the light, Uta transforms into Cure Idol, embracing her songs as a source of hope and power.

Source: Toei Animation

2025-02-05.name: Shiye Mowang
2025-02-05.desc:
Adapted from the light novel of the same name by Pineapple Bun, "The Unemployed Demon King", it tells the story of a powerful demon king who is looking for a job and taking risks in order to pay off his debts and find a way to lift the curse, and a rookie hero who is also working and taking risks in order to pay off her debts. The two are on a hilarious journey.

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2025-02-12.name: Junzi Wu Ji
2025-02-12.desc:
The third prince Liu Ling, who grew up in the cold palace, has a secret that is unknown to the public: he can see "gods" with his eyes! See how the down-and-out teenager Liu Ling encounters the fairy Yao Ji who descends from the sky, and with the help of a group of former concubines with special skills, he embarks on a passionate and romantic journey of counterattack and growth! The relationship between the two from different worlds gradually heats up, but they are unexpectedly involved in a foggy court game. The secrets of the gods and the mysteries of the concubines are revealed one by one...

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2025-02-14.desc:

2025-02-23.name: Chang Ge Xing
2025-02-23.desc:
Shortly after astrology predicts destruction to befall the Tang Dynasty, a coup d'état led by the crown prince Li's very own brother kills him and his wife and sons. Li's daughter, princess Yongning, manages to escape, but is soon declared dead alongside her family. Full of wrath, the princess swears to avenge them as she takes on the identity of a young man, Li Chang Ge, and moves to the Shou province to advance her goals.

Li Chang Ge uses her wits to gain the trust of the Shou emperor and swiftly climbs the military ranks as a brilliant strategist. Captivatingly drawn, Song of the Long March portrays the feisty girl's adolescent journey toward countless unknown adventures, faithful comradeship, as well as formidable enmity awaiting her along the way.

source: MAL

2025-02-26.name: Zui Qiang Shengji
2025-02-26.desc:
Our main guy, Zhao Fang, gets thrown into a fantasy world—but there’s a catch. He’s stuck as a powerless, disgraced young master, with only a loyal maid by his side. Sounds rough, right? But Zhao Fang isn’t sweating it. Thanks to his deep gaming experience, he quickly cracks the system, exploits game-breaking glitches, and starts power-leveling like a pro.

With every secret realm he conquers, Zhao Fang unlocks new abilities, takes on crazy system-assigned missions, and proves that he’s no ordinary player. He’s here to dominate the game world, one upgrade at a time.

source: themoviedb.org
